description: Read-only SPF flattening for a domain. Resolves the full include/a/mx/redirect graph to literal ip4/ip6 addresses and returns a single flattened SPF record that fits under the RFC-7208 10-lookup limit, plus lookup counts before/after, IP count, record length, whether it must be split across multiple records, and a maintenance warning.
